description: Either node (reset the INUBIT node), or leaseId with forget: true (end a lease whose reset failed, without contacting INUBIT)

node.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`) whose INUBIT node is reset

leaseId.description: Id of a lease whose automatic reset failed; only with forget: true

forget.description: Ends the lease leaseId without contacting INUBIT; the level may stay raised until that node restarts

confirmationCode.description: The code of the preview; omit it on the first call
